req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint returns 204 No Content on success and 404 when the task does not exist. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — delete an existing task, assert 204 and verify subsequent GET returns 404; (2) NEG — delete a non-existent task, assert exact 404 status and error detail; (3) BVA — delete task with id=1 (lowest seeded id, boundary), assert 204 and idempotent second delete returns 404; (4) STC — state transition: task exists → deleted → gone, verifying the state machine; (5) DT — delete with a non-integer task_id (string path segment), assert 422 unprocessable entity. Each test uses an in-process SQLite database reset via Base.metadata so it is fully isolated and deterministic.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: Task with id=5 exists (title='Write project report', completed=false)
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tmp}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)

from app import models
from datetime import datetime
db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=5, title='Write project report', description='Signal cascade', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,6,8,1,38,4)))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r = client.delete('/tasks/5')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''
    r2 = client.get('/tasks/5')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tmp)

import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tmp}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=10, title='Organize desk', description=None, completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,12,8,1,17)))
db.commit()
db.close()

    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

def test_delete_task_state_transition_exists_to_gone():

    assert r_post.status_code == 404

test_delete_task_state_transition_exists_to_gone()

import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

tmp = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tmp}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = TestingSession()
db.add(models.Task(id=2, title='Book flight tickets', description='Delta willow', completed=True, created_at=datetime(2025,5,12,18,49,0)))
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,41,54)))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_task_decision_table_completed_and_incomplete():
    r2 = client.delete('/tasks/2')
    assert r2.status_code == 204
    assert r2.content == b''
    r7 = client.delete('/tasks/7')
    assert r7.status_code == 204
    assert r7.content == b''
    assert client.get('/tasks/2').status_code == 404
    assert client.get('/tasks/7').status_code == 404

test_delete_task_decision_table_completed_and_incomplete()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
os.unlink(tmp)
